name: Broad-shouldered jar
dimensions: H. 40.2 x W. (across handles) 47 x Diam. 42.2 cm (15 13/16 x 18 1/2 x 16 5/8 in.)
summary: Ovoid jar with short, cylindrical neck, broad shoulders, sides tapering inward to a small, flat base, and two strap lug handles positioned bilaterally just below the shoulder; buff earthenware lightly burnished and decorated with geometric designs painted in black and burgundy slips before firing. Majiayao culture, Banshan type. From the upper Yellow River valley region; Gansu, Qinghai, or Ningxia province.
